name: lokashaka
description: Your Lokashaka character keeps you company while you code: she panics at errors, cheers when a run succeeds, and loves headpats.

commands.title: Lokashaka: Turn Character On or Off

lokashaka.character.description: Which of your characters to show. Empty follows the character running in the desktop app.

lokashaka.showCharacter.description: Show your character in the Lokashaka panel.

lokashaka.language.description: Language your character speaks in the panel.

lokashaka.desktopBridge.description: Follow the character running in the desktop app and send it your reactions.

lokashaka.reactToDiagnostics.description: React when the number of errors in your code goes up or reaches zero.

lokashaka.reactToTerminal.description: React to terminal commands and tasks finishing (needs shell integration).

lokashaka.minRunSeconds.description: Successful commands faster than this many seconds are not celebrated.

lokashaka.sleepAfterMinutes.description: Your character falls asleep in the panel after VS Code is unused for this many minutes.
